instruction: I am compiling 2012–2018 water-quality reference data for the Brazos River mainstem downstream of Brazos Rv at Waco, TX. For each of the three specified HUCs that include Waco (12060202, 12070101, 12070104), I need to identify one TCEQ monitoring station suitable as a long-term reference for 2012–2018 along the Brazos River mainstem downstream of Brazos Rv at Waco, TX. Candidate stations must satisfy all of the following: be located within the corresponding HUC; have a monitoring-location type of River/Stream on the station detail page; have a station name that still corresponds to the Brazos River mainstem, not a tributary or other named waterbody; and have records covering 2012–2018 for all five characteristic groups—Inorganics, Major, Non-metals; Microbiological; Nutrient; Organics, Other; and Physical—meaning the station’s start year is no later than 2012 and its end year is no earlier than 2018. List the three results in upstream-to-downstream order, one per line, using the format: <HUC>|<MonitoringLocationIdentifier>|<earliest year when all five groups are jointly available>|<Inorganics, Major, Non-metals start year>|<Microbiological start year>|<Nutrient start year>|<Organics, Other start year>|<Physical start year>.
output_format: List the three results in upstream-to-downstream order, one per line, using the format: <HUC>|<MonitoringLocationIdentifier>|<earliest year when all five groups are jointly available>|<Inorganics, Major, Non-metals start year>|<Microbiological start year>|<Nutrient start year>|<Organics, Other start year>|<Physical start year>.
